rows.passage: Few things will stand out are the fact that the business is becoming more diversified and resilient . Over the 2019 to 2025 timeframe, industrial exports have been flat at around Rs.1,600 crores despite oil and gas declining from around Rs.1,100, Rs.1,200 crores to about Rs.400 crores.
